name: 423. DashScope Wan video: create per family, task object, cancel, list (dashscope wan video)
description: Pins TXE-6432 (contract C4, C5, C6, C7, C9; vendor sheet Alibaba, video B11 to B15): Wan video on the dashscope provider. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: start tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs, start an isolated gateway on tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json (dashscope has both bases at the fixture's /pp/dashscope) and run with providerErrorFixture=1; every case is skipped otherwise. The fixture answers in DashScope's documented shapes and keeps every request it receives, with its method and X-DashScope-Async header, in /__wire. Rows 2 to 4: a Wan 3.0, a Wan 2.7 and a Wan 2.6 create each reach DashScope in their family's shape (input.media with resolution and ratio; resolution and ratio; parameters.size as 1280*720). Rows 5 to 8: each task control field is refused with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter, because DashScope has no parameter for it. Row 9: a size outside the Wan 2.6 tiers is refused, not moved to a tier. Row 10 reads the capture: three creates, each with X-DashScope-Async: enable and the exact body, and nothing from the five refused requests. Rows 11 to 14: a task query builds the task object (completed with usage.output_seconds, usage.input_seconds, the vendor link and expires_at 24 hours after submit_time read as UTC+8; failed with content_filter for DataInspectionFailed and IPInfringementSuspect; expired for UNKNOWN). Row 15: cancel on a PENDING task. Row 16: cancel on a RUNNING task is 400 provider_cancel_unsupported. Row 17 reads the capture: every query and cancel was exactly one call. Rows 18 and 19: the video list reaches GET /api/v1/tasks with limit as page_size and DashScope's own filters (start_time, end_time, a repeated status, page_no) unchanged, and next is the following page number until DashScope's total_page. Row 20: an after cursor is refused with 400, because DashScope pages by number. Row 21 reads the capture: two list calls with the exact queries, none for the refused request. Row 22: with x-bf-passthrough-extra-params on, a size nested under a parameters extra param is refused with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming parameters.size, because the nested key is out of sight of the price-field check and would be merged into the vendor body. Row 23 reads the capture: no fourth create reached DashScope. Red before the change: every row from 2 on was 400 unsupported_operation. Rows 24 to 26: the download. dashscope's proxy_config is the fixture's media tunnel, so the task ds-media-gapped can name its file at 203.0.113.10 (public to the SSRF check, routed nowhere): GET /v1/videos/{id}/content queries the task once and forwards the file as it arrives, the first byte reaching the caller before the file host wrote the second half. A task that names a file on the fixture's loopback address is refused with 500 and the signed query is not echoed. Row 26 reads the capture and the hit counters: one task query per download, the file asked for at the public address through a tunnel, the loopback file never asked for.
